text.description_html:
INOX GD120B, Stainless Steel 2-1/16 Inch Round Double Cylinder Deadbolt

While the GD Series deadbolt requires a custom door preparation, its smaller size adds to the modern appeal. The Sleek and Small Double Cylinder Deadbolt looks great on new builds because its smaller footprint looks so modern, especially when paired with one of INOX's matching Stainless Steel Leversets. The Stainless Steel 2-1/16 Inch Round Double Cylinder Deadbolt is available in polished stainless steel, satin stainless steel, and oil rubbed bronze stainless steel finishes. A single cylinder deadbolt, it is locked and unlocked by a key from the outside and also from the inside.

Double Cylinder: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from exterior and by a key from the interior

Features of the Round Double Cylinder Stainless Steel Deadbolt:

  • Keyway: Schlage C, 5-pin
  • Concealed M5 thru-bolt installation.
  • For residential or light-duty commercial applications.

Specifications of the INOX GD120B 2-1/16" Diameter Stainless Steel Door Lock:

  • Material: Solid Cast Stainless Steel Outside Escutcheon and Wrought Stainless Steel Inside Escutcheon.
  • Diameter: 2-1/16"
  • Exterior Projection: 19/32"
  • Interior Rose Projection: 19/32"
  • Deadbolt" 1" throw
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Not for use on 2-1/8" pre-drilled doors.
